Well, if paying 4 pool and two actions (recruit+equip) for someone who can bleed for a whole 1 is considered a reasonable deal in your neck of the woods, knock yourself out. You should team Talaq up with Mehemet

Most other places, however, there are much better things to spend pool, actions, and card slots on.

> mirddes wrote:
> and robert carter
>
Talaq can't employ him, because Talaq has no blood and Robert Carter does not require either Thaumaturgy or Quietus.
Talaq may play cards that require basic Quietus [qui] or basic Thaumaturgy [tha] as a vampire with a capacity of 3.

You can't Heidelberg Robert Carter to Talaq, because Heidelberg works between vampires and Talaq isn't work.
Tap to move blood, equipment cards and/or retainers between any two ready vampires you control.

If you move Robert Carter to Talaq somehow, Talaq gets no bleed bonus from him because Talaq is not a vampire.
The vampire with this retainer gets +2 bleed.

If you move Robert Carter to Talaq somehow, Robert burns during your next untap phase, because Talaq has no blood to burn (not being a vampire), the same as an empty vampire can't burn blood.
During your untap phase, Carter's employer burns 1 blood, or Carter is burned.
